name: USB endoscope (Realtek 0bda:5806)
notes: Generic USB 2.0 endoscope on a Realtek chip; the device calls itself "Generic USB Camera". The sensor delivers at most 640x480 natively (also 352x288 and 320x240), always reported as 30 fps; in dim light auto exposure brings the real rate down to about 10 fps. Chrome on macOS exposes no hardware controls for it, so use the image sliders.
